# Arc layout at a big Size, fix/layout198 (Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720, the usual FOV 70, the demo song): a long line cut
# into rows that fit across the screen can be taller than the screen. Main centres it on its spot (a little above the
# crosshair), so its top row, the first words sung, reaches over the screen's top edge; the branch scrolls it, like a line
# of more than about nine rows already did, so the words being sung stay near the crosshair. Row counts are worked out
# from the layout's geometry with the font's widths guessed at about 6 units a letter, so take them as rough.
# Each shot, the branch against main:
# - layout198-size1 (Size 1, the 28-word test line, most words out): the same on both, about three rows well inside.
# - layout198-size25-start (Size 2.5, the same line 2 s in, its first words out): main: the top row runs into or past the
#   top edge, the first words cut or out of sight; branch: the first words a little above the crosshair, the block below
#   them reaching under the bottom edge (those words come later).
# - layout198-size25-late (Size 2.5, most words out): main: as before, top row at or past the top edge; branch: scrolled
#   up so the newest words are near the crosshair, the first rows above the top edge (already sung).
# - layout198-short25 (Size 2.5, the short line "Glow on"): one row inside the screen on both.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/layout198 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/layout198.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/layout198 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/layout198.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout ARC
look 0 -20
sleep 6
fastlines 20000 Lanterns drifting over the sleepy town below us all night while paper boats keep sailing down the silver river past the quiet mill and every window hums along | Glow on
set size 1
seek 10.4
sleep 1.4
shot layout198-size1
set size 2.5
seek 0.6
sleep 1.4
shot layout198-size25-start
seek 10.4
sleep 1.4
shot layout198-size25-late
seek 21
sleep 1.4
shot layout198-short25
